# apple_game_center_challenge (Resource)

Creates a Game Center challenge, in which players compete with friends on a leaderboard, for an app or for a group of apps. Add its name with `apple_game_center_challenge_localization` and its images with `apple_game_center_challenge_default_image` and `apple_game_center_challenge_image`, then submit it with `apple_submit_game_center_challenge`. Destroying the resource deletes the challenge; one that has been live can't be deleted, so it is archived instead. Import it by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apple_game_center_challenge" "example" {
  game_center_detail_id = apple_game_center_detail.example.id
  reference_name        = "Weekly duel"
  vendor_identifier     = "com.example.weekly_duel"
  challenge_type        = "LEADERBOARD"
  leaderboard_id        = apple_game_center_leaderboard.weekly.id
  repeatable            = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `challenge_type` (String) Kind of challenge: `LEADERBOARD`. Changing it creates a new challenge.
- `leaderboard_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the leaderboard the challenge is played on, of the same app or group, e.g. `apple_game_center_leaderboard.example.id`.
- `reference_name` (String) Name of the challenge in App Store Connect.
- `vendor_identifier` (String) Identifier the game knows the challenge by, e.g. `com.example.weekly_duel`. Changing it creates a new challenge.

### Optional

- `archived` (Boolean) Whether the challenge is archived, which hides it from players. Defaults to `false`.
- `game_center_detail_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the app's Game Center detail, e.g. `apple_game_center_detail.example.id`. Set this or `game_center_group_id`.
- `game_center_group_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of a Game Center group, for a challenge its apps share. Set this or `game_center_detail_id`.
- `repeatable` (Boolean) Whether players can take the challenge again. Unset keeps App Store Connect's value.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the Game Center challenge.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = apple_game_center_challenge.example
  identity = {
    id = "1d3f5a7c-9b2e-4c6d-8a0f-2b4c6d8e0f1a"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the Game Center challenge.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import apple_game_center_challenge.example 1d3f5a7c-9b2e-4c6d-8a0f-2b4c6d8e0f1a
```
